name: translator-brief
title: DRAFT translator handoff
for_each: select id,name from projects order by name

sections.title: Translation and review work
sections.sql: select * from translation_status where project_id=$1 order by key,locale
sections.note: Check meaning, tone and context with a competent reviewer. Nothing is sent.

name: release-signoff
title: DRAFT localisation release checklist
for_each: select id,name from projects order by name

sections.title: Language readiness
sections.sql: select project,locale,total,ready,blocked from release_readiness where project_id=$1 order by locale

sections.title: Reviewer evidence
sections.sql: select s.name,t.locale,t.reviewer,t.reviewed_version,s.version current_source_version,t.evidence,t.reviewed_at from strings s join translations t on t.string_id=s.id where s.project_id=$1 order by s.name,t.locale
sections.note: Readiness is a record check, not a legal opinion or linguistic certification. A separate person approves deployment.
